sequence: review pinned source with GPT without case-specific HorusTrace findings
method.important_limit: GPT is a differential oracle, not ground truth. Agreement is a confidence signal; disagreement is a source-review target.

cross_case_findings.evidence: GPT identified 11 source-supported end-to-end paths across five cases; HorusTrace emitted 3, all in rw-152.
cross_case_findings.next_step: Prioritize source-proven ingress binding and path assembly across ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents, and custom MCP loops.

cross_case_findings.evidence: rw-112: HorusTrace detects run_python as an unbound process tool while source proves the default workspace MCP is connected, list_tools() is converted to OpenAI tools, and function calls dispatch through session.call_tool().
cross_case_findings.next_step: Resolve source-proven local fallback/config MCP servers into effective authority before applying process/tool rules.

cross_case_findings.evidence: rw-152: source declares critical model-to-exec paths, but agent.py references undefined settings during presentation_agent construction. HorusTrace reports three runtime PATH001 findings without surfacing that the pinned app import appears blocked.
cross_case_findings.next_step: Add a source viability/initialization status so declared static authority can be distinguished from proven runnable authority.

cross_case_findings.evidence: Specific state/destructive findings are frequently duplicated by generic AGT040 on the same agent/tool (rw-017, rw-065, rw-139, rw-152).
cross_case_findings.next_step: Suppress or group generic approval findings when a more specific rule already represents the identical authority/control gap.

runtime_qualification_gap.claim: agent.py references model_settings=settings while no definition/import of settings exists in the pinned source. This appears to block module import before the declared agents become runnable.
runtime_qualification_gap.horustrace_behavior: Reports PATH001 as runtime findings/attack paths and only marks analysis_incomplete=true; it does not expose the source-level viability blocker.
runtime_qualification_gap.recommended_semantics: Retain declared/static risk, but downgrade reachability from runnable/proven to conditional or initialization-blocked.

attack_path_gap.qualification_difference: GPT marks all three conditional on fixing the current import blocker.
